runtime.python: 3.13.2 (Windows reference validation); Linux guest records its own version

task: Validate inventory request, call authorized mock lookup, pause after lookup, resume and explain whether requested quantity is available.

hidden_tests.deployment: trusted grader store only; never student image

mandatory_invariants: lookup occurs exactly once for valid input
checkpoint after lookup; resume schedules explanation
invalid input causes zero tool calls
thread identity bound to authenticated tenant/session

correctness.1: Major errors in reasoning or unsupported tool claim
correctness.2: Partly correct with one material omission
correctness.4: Correct, complete and directly supported by observed evidence

clarity.3: Clear explanation with one minor ambiguity
clarity.4: Concise, explicit units and traceable steps

grading.deterministic_normalization: D is the weighted passed subtest weight divided by total fixed subtest weight
grading.semantic_normalization: S is the weighted mean applicable criterion level divided by 4; NOT_APPLICABLE criteria are excluded from the denominator
grading.missing_or_abstained_criteria: ABSTAIN, missing, malformed, or inconsistent applicability produces REVIEW; all criteria NOT_APPLICABLE produces REVIEW
